notes: This is the COVER PAGE of the sitting: masthead, presiding officers, and the attendance roll in two columns. NO SPEECH AT ALL — utterance_starts is deliberately empty, so anything the parser attributes to a speaker on this page is a false positive. The names are printed surname-first in caps, which is the roll format, not speaker labels. Two flaws to flag. First, a typesetting slip in the presiding line: 'H. Senado,doctor José Genoud' has no space after the comma. Second, the page carries two small pale-orange square marks sitting alone on otherwise blank lines — one between the end of the right-hand column ('ZALAZAR, Horacio Aníbal') and the word 'LICENCIA', another far down the empty left margin near the foot of the page. I enlarged both; they are not characters and not punctuation, and they look like broken image placeholders or stray bullets left in the file. Nothing is illegible.
